summary: Boston Scientific Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a cybersecurity incident discovered on August 25, 2026, causing global operational disruptions, including impacts on order processing and shipping. The company activated incident response protocols and engaged third-party experts; investigation is ongoing and materiality is undetermined. This is a routine current report of an operational event, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms or alternative actions are present; the filing is informational and forward-looking. What to watch: further disclosures on operational recovery and financial impact.
